name: Sentinel Augustus
desc:
Sentinel Augustus is an Adret NPC. He is part of the Shock Trooper division for [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority).

He received his current position after [Sentinel Faris Kesset](entity:sentinel_faris_kesset) was killed by [Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus). The at the time Operator Augustus was close to the late Sentinel, and was eventually assigned her position by [Warden Jericho](entity:warden_jericho). He swore to avenge her, and eventually did so when he captured General Destellus.

He wields the Duskguard Axe. As signified by his Resonance he is moderately strong.
goals: Avenge [Sentinel Faris Kesset](entity:sentinel_faris_kesset), who fell to [Titus Fulminus Destellus](entity:titus_fulminus_destellus)
